summary: High Bluff portfolio identifies Church's as a leading global chicken QSR, acquired in September 2021, with 1,500+ restaurants across the U.S. and 26 other countries.
Church's appointed Kevin Nemeth EVP / Chief Commercial Officer in May 2026 to oversee brand, marketing, digital, loyalty, CRM, guest engagement, menu, pricing, product innovation, and revenue growth.
NRN reported Church's received Golub Capital growth equity in July 2026 to accelerate remodels, company-operated restaurant openings, and franchisee-growth initiatives.
Restaurant Dive reported the funding will accelerate remodels and growth; CEO Roland Gonzalez said 2026 same-store sales and traffic were up.
Qu case study says Church's used Qu to modernize POS and restaurant operations, improve drive-thru wait times, increase order volume, and integrate POS to KDS / ordering flows.
QSR Web's 2021 coverage says Church's selected Qu for roughly 1,000 U.S. locations, with SynergySuite, Bridg, and HonorBuilt named in the refresh ecosystem.
PAR announced Church's selected Punchh for Real Rewards loyalty; PAR case-study marketing cites 400K+ first-quarter sign-ups and about 20% spend lift.
DTiQ / Envysion evidence points to managed video/loss-prevention and Qu POS integration in Church's environment.
Maggie Lenhart reported a live Church's call: Jeff Caplin is finalizing a five-year Qu POS renewal and is interested in upgrading digital menu boards; Jeff may stop by FSTEC to speak with Todd.
Prior RB account intelligence says Church's previously evaluated Genius and rejected it as a junior-varsity platform. Treat Church's as relationship recovery, not a warm POS path.
RB baseline canonicalizes Jeff Caplin as CTO at Church's Texas Chicken and former Hooters CTO; 'Caplan/Kaplan' spellings are known normalization errors.
